units.title: Verify: Entry point and App render unit tests

tests.name: entry point > Given index.html, then it declares the #root mount node and the main.tsx module script

tests.scenario: Given index.html, then it declares the #root mount node and the main.tsx module script
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/entry.test.tsx --testTimeout=20000
tests.detail: index.html contains id="root" and src="/src/main.tsx"; src/main.tsx exists.

tests.name: entry point > Given a #root element exists, when main is imported, then createRoot mounts on it and render is called once

tests.scenario: Given a #root element exists, when main is imported, then createRoot mounts on it and render is called once
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/entry.test.tsx --testTimeout=20000
tests.detail: createRoot (mocked) called with the #root element; its render mock called once.

tests.name: entry point > Given no #root element, when main is imported, then it throws a missing root error
tests.title: main throws a missing-root error when #root is absent
tests.scenario: Given no #root element, when main is imported, then it throws a missing root error
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/entry.test.tsx --testTimeout=20000
tests.detail: Import rejects with 'Root element #root not found'.

tests.name: entry point > Given the App component, when rendered, then the Begin button is shown
